result.summary: The page mostly looks fine, but there is one clear defect: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section title ('home_feed.popular_title') instead of a human-readable heading like 'Popular near you'.

issues.description: The section heading above the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for this key (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback/default string so raw keys never render to users.
